description: New labels: deepseek-v4.1-flash with labeling guidance G1 (experiments/emotion/guidance.py: the gold label is the emotion category of the word attached to feel/feeling, ignoring negation/context, plus a word->category list) and the 20 v2 seeds as few-shot examples, on 10,000 pool texts (the 4,903 v1-labeled uids first, then random). Labeler dev agreement 0.785 (half B, never used to write the guidance: 0.73) vs 0.54 for seeds only and 0.49 plain. Student: gte-modernbert full fine-tune, lr 3e-5, bs 32, max 3 epochs (best 2), max_len 96, seed 0, early stopping on 10% held-out silver. Dev: 10k labels 0.800/0.790 (2 seeds), 5k 0.795/0.780, 2.5k 0.735; v1 seeded labels 0.600. Served as fp32 ONNX because int8 cost 2 dev points (0.80 -> 0.78, on both the 5k and 10k models) and fp32 p95 is 44 ms.
